title: Daily Purification and the Two Faces of the Heavenly Prosopon
description: Two short paired teachings on ongoing refinement. (T79) The soul recognizes the entire archonic host within her, and through the daily nourishment of Divine Truth she purifies, cleanses, filters, and washes forth the mingling of Darkness — regeneration as steady, dietary, daily work of separation. (T80) The single heavenly prosopon bears two faces: agape (beauty with longing) and the love-of-strife — the heavens habitually refining the second on account of the Living Soul still mingled in them.
